name: orthogonal_atom_geometry_v22
method: Algebraic weight-space programming without training or gradients
hypothesis: Reference coordinates and chemical features are summed in the same affine atom embedding. Every chemical component parallel to the three coordinate columns acts as a feature-dependent coordinate offset. The earlier v4 edit removed only second-character digit offsets. Remove the coordinate-parallel part from all non-coordinate columns while preserving the coordinate map exactly. This creates a clean linear reference-coordinate subspace before nonlinear encoding; it does not establish that downstream layers will use handedness correctly. Chemical features retain their orthogonal components, and protein effects must be measured.
